about: Materials checked against the gltf target, and against Blender's glTF exporter by base-node-for-blender/tests/test_gltf_export.py. A case is a `body` of `shader(material: true) graph <name>() -> (<outputs>)`, or a whole `text` where NAME is its name. `issues` are the links the rules refuse. `gltf` is what the exported material shows: `path` is there, `!path` is not, `path=value` equals it; `mesh.` names an attribute of the mesh, `sampler.` a field of its first sampler, `json.` the whole file. `gltf_warnings` are what Blender's exporter warns about it, each a part of its message: a warning not listed fails the case. An accepted case shows what reached the glTF, a refused one what was lost.

cases.name: base_texture
cases.body:
t = ImageTexture[image: "Paint"](vector: UVMap())
return (surface: PrincipledBSDF(base_color: t))
